desc.zh: 反大型部队可以有效应对体积至少等同马匹的目标。这一特性会有很多具体表现形式，如面对大型目标时的[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]伤害加成，或者可以集聚到很小一片区域的强力攻击等等。然而鉴于大型部队的攻击一般过于缓慢且容易在近战中闪避开，所以很多部队天生便可更有效地应对这些敌军
desc.en: Anti-large units have an advantage against targets that are at least as large as a horse. This advantage can be a [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against large targets or an attack that focuses on a very small area. However, some units are simply better against large targets because their attacks are slow and easy to dodge by skilled melee combatants.

desc.zh: 具有[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲属性的武器可在大多数情况下无视目标的护甲，这让他们成为了对抗重甲部队时的有效选择。但这些部队一般较为重型，且攻击频率不高，这也让他们在对抗轻装部队时显得有些吃力
desc.en: The damage of [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]armour-piercing weapons mostly ignores the armour of the target, making them the ideal choice against heavily-armoured enemies. They are often heavier and attack at a slower rate though, making them less efficient against poorly-armoured targets.

desc.zh: 重甲部队可以扣减除了[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲杀伤之外的所有种类的杀伤
desc.en: Armoured units can block damage from any source apart from [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]Armour-Piercing damage.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 当[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗大型部队冲锋时会无视其所有的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When bracing[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]], this unit negates the [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus of any large attacker.

desc.zh: 当[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整时，这支部队可以对冲锋而来的敌军造成额外伤害
desc.en: When [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.

desc.zh: 怒气一旦烧起来，就只能拿敌人的血去浇熄。
desc.en: Once his anger catches fire, only the enemy's blood can put it out.

desc.zh: 言出必践，赏罚不私。故而部下肯把后背交给他。
desc.en: He keeps every word he gives, and metes out reward and punishment without favour. That is why his men trust him to guard their backs.

desc.zh: 他相信秽乱起于人心的缝隙，因此从不放过任何一句支吾其词。
desc.en: He believes corruption takes root in the smallest cracks of the human heart, and so he never lets a single evasive word pass unnoticed.

desc.zh: 兵法、汉籍、异国海图，凡是能读的他都读，凡是读过的他都记得。
desc.en: Treatises of war, Cathayan classics, charts from foreign seas: whatever can be read, he reads, and whatever he has read, he remembers.

desc.zh: 弓马刀枪自幼日课，未曾一日间断。纵使刀折矢尽，这具身体本身仍是他最后一件兵器。
desc.en: Bow, horse, blade and spear have been his daily discipline since childhood, without a single day's interruption. Even should his sword break and his arrows run out, his own body remains his last weapon.

desc.zh: 账簿、工役、仓廪，在他眼里与阵图无异。治所井然，军势才养得起来。
desc.en: Ledgers, labour and granaries are, to him, no different from battle maps. Only a well-ordered domain can sustain an army.

desc.zh: 一身重甲穿了半辈子，如今倒像是长在身上，卸下来反而不自在。
desc.en: Half a lifetime spent in heavy armour has made it feel almost part of him; taking it off now feels stranger than wearing it.

desc.zh: 阵形尚未动，胜负已在他心里排演过一遍。
desc.en: Before the formation even moves, he has already rehearsed the battle's outcome in his mind.

desc.zh: 身后是海，退无可退——所以他从来不退。
desc.en: The sea is at his back, with nowhere left to retreat – so he never does.

desc.zh: 净袍加身，浊世之秽不沾其上。
desc.en: Clad in pure white robes, untouched by the corruption of the mundane world.

desc.zh: 一呼一吸皆有其度，神事自始至终不乱。
desc.en: Every breath in, every breath out, has its measure, so the sacred rite unfolds without disorder from start to end.

desc.zh: 御札钉处，邪祟俯首——纵是千军之将，寸步难行。
desc.en: Where the ofuda is pinned, evil spirits bow their heads; even a general commanding a thousand troops cannot take a single step.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 巫女虚挽神弓，以破魔矢之咒射出净光。
desc.en: The Miko draws a sacred bow from empty air and looses a bolt of purifying light with the rite of Hamaya.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 铃声一止，阵中便少了一个人；再一止，又少了一个。
desc.en: The instant the bell falls silent, one soldier vanishes from the line; when it falls silent again, another follows.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 初执神乐铃者所受的第一课：破魔之矢自此在手。
desc.en: The first lesson for any who takes up the kagura bells: from this day, the Hamaya is hers to wield.

desc.zh: 御币一振，月露般的清辉落在伤者之间。
desc.en: With a single sweep of her gohei, a radiance like moonlit dew settles over the wounded.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 狐群闻铃而至，替巫女扑向阵前。
desc.en: The fox pack hears the bell and comes, pouncing on the enemy line in the Miko's stead.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 千瓣落樱皆是刃，过处不留邪祟。
desc.en: Each of the thousand falling petals is a blade, and no evil spirit survives their passing.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 神事既起，邪祟自退。
desc.en: Once the sacred rite begins, evil spirits retreat of their own accord.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 巫女以身为依代，神明暂寄其中。
desc.en: The Miko offers her body as a yorishiro, a vessel where the gods may briefly dwell.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 灼骨观兆，先知者不惊。
desc.en: Scorching bone to read the omens: one who foresees is never caught off guard.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 神饌既备，神使自来。
desc.en: Once the divine offering is prepared, the divine envoy comes of its own accord.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 绳既张，界既立——自此内为神域，外为浊世。
desc.en: Once the rope is strung and the boundary set – all within it becomes divine domain, all beyond it the mundane world.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 家系战败、领地尽失，她仍是那个亲提双刀率旗本冲阵的当主——名分能被夺走，治军用人的本事夺不走。她驻扎之处，营造有度，刀锋有主。
desc.en: Her house defeated and her lands lost, she is still the head of the house who charges into battle with twin blades and her hatamoto at her back; her title may be stripped from her, but her skill in commanding troops cannot be taken. Wherever she makes camp, order takes hold, and every blade knows its master.

desc.zh: 只在圣木林间现身的祥瑞，唯有德望者能得其俯首。
desc.en: An auspicious beast that appears only within sacred groves, bowing its head to none but those of virtue and renown.

desc.zh: 武家将领的坐骑，久经阵战，闻鼓不惊。
desc.en: The mount of a samurai commander, seasoned in battle and unshaken by the sound of war drums.

desc.zh: 只在圣木林间现身的祥瑞，唯有德望者能得其俯首。
desc.en: An auspicious beast that appears only within sacred groves, bowing its head to none but those of virtue and renown.

desc.zh: 武家将领的坐骑，久经阵战，闻鼓不惊。
desc.en: The mount of a samurai commander, seasoned in battle and unshaken by the sound of war drums.

desc.zh: 剑豪不止精通于刀剑一种武器。他们熟练掌握各种武器并有所应对。
desc.en: Master swordsmen are not limited to the blade alone. They are well versed in every weapon, and know how to counter any of them.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 火器不仅讲究熟练度，更讲究纪律。
desc.en: Firearms demand not only skill, but discipline above all.

desc.zh: 武家的传统不在血统，而在刀锋相传的一念。
desc.en: The samurai tradition lies not in bloodline, but in a single resolve passed down from blade to blade.

desc.zh: 只有强大的英雄才能驾驭麒麟。
desc.en: Only a hero of great strength can master a Kirin.

desc.zh: 疾如风，徐如林，侵掠如火，不动如山。
desc.en: Swift as the wind, quiet as the forest, fierce as fire, immovable as the mountain.

desc.zh: 武士大将已参透死亡，向死而生。
desc.en: The Samurai Taisho has made peace with death itself, and finds life by facing it.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 所属军队的全部尼朋单位近战攻击、近战防御与领导力提升。
desc.en: Increases melee attack, melee defence and leadership for all Nipponese units in the army.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 调息以维持阴阳术的流转。
desc.en: Regulating her breath to keep the flow of her onmyo arts steady.

desc.zh: 镜山传承的护身修持。
desc.en: A protective discipline handed down by Kagamiyama.

desc.zh: 镜山神社最后一位传人的基础能力：魔法之风法力储量提升，法术失误几率降低，并解锁被动技能"生命绽放"。
desc.en: The base ability of the last heir of the Kagamiyama shrine: increased Winds of Magic power reserves, reduced miscast chance, and unlocks the passive ability "Life Bloom".

desc.zh: 阴以夺其坚，阳以壮我锋——一镜之内，两气同行。
desc.en: Yin to strip away their defence, yang to sharpen our blade – within a single mirror, both energies flow as one.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 镜能映照两界，也让军团的灵性与生机相互流转。
desc.en: The mirror reflects both worlds, letting spirit and vitality flow freely through the army.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 神乐一奏，土地与人心一同安定下来。
desc.en: As the kagura dance begins, both land and hearts are set at ease.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 出阵前，尼朋的每一支队伍都从巫女手里接过一枚御守。
desc.en: Before marching to battle, every Nipponese unit receives an omamori from the hands of the miko.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 神乐铃引来诸神的微光，护佑近旁的同伴。
desc.en: The kagura bells draw the gods' faint light, warding the allies nearby.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 师父留下的神乐铃既是法器，也是松动封印的钥匙。
desc.en: The kagura bells left by her master are both a ritual implement and a key that loosens the seal.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 神乐铃三振，云气自镜面翻涌而出。
desc.en: Three shakes of the kagura bells, and clouds surge forth from the mirror's surface.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 伊瑟拉玛银制的披甲战马，迅捷而坚韧。
desc.en: A barded warhorse of Ithilmar, swift and enduring.

desc.zh: 由银战马牵引的轻型战车，冲击凌厉。
desc.en: A light chariot drawn by silver steeds, fierce in its charge.

desc.zh: 一头银月龙的庞大身躯，俯瞰整个战场。
desc.en: The colossal form of a Moon Dragon looks down upon the entire battlefield.

desc.zh: 海神马瑟兰庇佑她所在的舰队，凡她参战的海战全军皆受护佑，她指引的航路亦更长远。
desc.en: The Sea God Mathlann watches over her fleet: every naval battle she takes part in brings protection to the whole force, and the routes she charts stretch farther still.

desc.zh: 久经海战与囚禁磨砺的战斗本能。
desc.en: Combat instincts honed by years of naval battle and captivity.

desc.zh: 艾斯林舰队传承的操练之道，让凡人水手如臂使指。
desc.en: A drilling tradition passed down through the Aesling fleets, making mortal sailors answer her command as surely as her own hands.

desc.zh: 凌驾普通迷雾法师之上的终极形态，被海神庇佑、掌握迷雾的迷雾大魔导师。
desc.en: The ultimate form beyond an ordinary Mist Mage, a Mist Archmage blessed by the Sea God and master of the mists.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 跨洋漂流三十载、幽囚十二年而不倒，海与囚笼都未能磨灭她的复原力。
desc.en: Thirty years adrift across the ocean and twelve years in captivity failed to break her; neither the sea nor the cage could wear down her resilience.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 曾任海上巡逻队迷雾法师副官，星象与海流在她脑中如掌纹般清晰。
desc.en: A former deputy to a Mist Mage of a sea patrol, she knows the stars and currents as well as the lines of her own palm.

desc.zh: 深海生灵与她共鸣，海神马瑟兰的眷顾延伸至她召唤的潮汐之灵。
desc.en: Creatures of the deep resonate with her, and Mathlann's favour extends to the tidal spirits she calls forth.

desc.zh: 唯有值得追随的统帅，才驾驭得了这匹玉龙马。
desc.en: Only a commander worth following can master this Jade Longma.

desc.zh: 吸收了海元素的玉龙马，被海军视作能够凌云破浪的祥瑞坐骑。
desc.en: A Jade Longma that has absorbed a Sea Elemental, regarded by the navy as an auspicious mount capable of soaring past the clouds and cutting through the waves.

desc.zh: 玉海舰队的统帅受到远东海洋的庇护。
desc.en: The commander of the Jade Sea Fleet is protected by the seas of the Far East.

desc.zh: 真正的剑圣往往精通数种不同的武器，比如刀剑和长枪。
desc.en: A true swordmaster is often skilled in several different weapons, such as swords and spears.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 随提督征战的老兵们身经百战。
desc.en: The veterans who have campaigned alongside the admiral are battle-hardened.

desc.zh: 震旦的剑法在尼朋的战士之间仍然通用。
desc.en: Cathayan swordsmanship is still widely practised among Nipponese warriors.

desc.zh: 震旦航海术历史悠久，声名远扬。
desc.en: Cathayan seamanship boasts a long history and a far-reaching reputation.

desc.zh: 先发制人，攻其不备。
desc.en: Strike first, and catch the enemy unprepared.

desc.zh: 「要火药还是魔法？」——「为何不能都要？」
desc.en: "Powder or sorcery?" - "Why not both?"

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 虽已不受朝廷承认，但仍是远东海域最为强大的水师。
desc.en: No longer recognised by the court, it remains the mightiest fleet in the far eastern seas.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 久历风浪的统帅最明白如何在远征中维持补给与军心。
desc.en: A commander seasoned by wind and wave knows best how to keep supplies flowing and morale high on a long expedition.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 凌云破浪，万里长风。
desc.en: He soars past the clouds and cuts through the waves, borne by a wind that carries for ten thousand miles.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 缴获自尼朋的名刀「逆潮」，逆流而上，随她一路远征。
desc.en: A famed Nipponese blade taken as a war trophy. Sakashio cuts against the current, and has followed her the whole way on this expedition.

desc.zh: 卫东水师的制式佩枪「镇澜」重新回到她手里——朝廷收得回兵权，收不回一杆枪。
desc.en: The Wei-Dong Fleet's standard-issue spear, Wave-Queller, is back in her hand – the court could reclaim her command, but never this spear.

desc.zh: 双刀攻防一体，滴水不漏。
desc.en: With two blades, offence and defence merge as one, leaving not a single opening.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 率旗本征战的当主，她的武范是麾下武士的标尺。
desc.en: As head of the house leading her hatamoto into battle, her martial example sets the standard for the samurai under her command.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 隐姓埋名于乡野铲奸除恶的岁月，练就了一身安民治地的本事。
desc.en: Years spent living incognito in the countryside, rooting out corruption and evil, honed her skill in pacifying the land and its people.

desc.zh: 同承雷神之契的旗本与她心意相通。
desc.en: The hatamoto who share her pact with Raijin are of one mind with her.

desc.zh: 雷刃剑豪的高速突阵，雷厉而至，一击破阵。
desc.en: The Thunderblade master swordsman's high-speed charge arrives like thunder, breaking the enemy line with a single strike.

desc.zh: 紫电一闪，斩雷断阵。
desc.en: A flash of Shiden splits the thunder and shatters the enemy line.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 能成为旗本的武士早已在剑术上登峰造极。
desc.en: A samurai who has risen to become a hatamoto has already mastered swordsmanship to its very peak.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 若无法守护应当守护之人，纵使苟活，武士亦与死人无异。
desc.en: A samurai who cannot protect those they are duty-bound to protect is no different from the dead, even if they cling to life.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 使用巨剑斩开射来的箭矢，这是一项很难学习的技术：剑刃领主们并不鼓励这种训练，但真正的剑圣可不会让谨慎占了荣誉的上风
desc.en: The art of deflecting arrows with a greatsword is painful to learn; such training is discouraged by Bladelord officers, but no true Swordmaster will let caution best his pride.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

desc.zh: 这支部队的主要职责是近战部队，但也可以进行远程攻击
desc.en: This unit is primarily a melee unit, but has missile capability too

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 那些跑得特别快的家伙会更快地到达敌军那里
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 身为领主，要有钢铁般的意志与绝不服输的气势，这样在面临险境时，麾下众将的立场才会坚定，并追随其至天涯海角
desc.en: The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.

desc.zh: 此人绝不会轻易屈膝，除非他的意志与躯体全部被彻底地毁灭
desc.en: This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 潮水会减慢敌人的前进速度
desc.en: The tidal currents shall slow the foe's advance.

desc.zh: 这艘鬼气森森的船上，竟是空无一人
desc.en: No one sails this ship of fools.

desc.zh: 不论是加强训练，轻装行进，减少进食还是提高睡眠质量，人总有办法在一天中做成更多事
desc.en: Whether it be training harder, travelling lighter, eating less or sleeping better, there's always a way to draw more from the day.

desc.zh: 军中战士可以在这位冠军勇士的力量下得到救助或补充
desc.en: Those in the army can find succour or be replenished by the power of this champion.

desc.zh: 该勇士崇尚军纪，害怕走上战场的同时却又害怕远离战场
desc.en: This champion extols discipline and fear away from the battlefield as much as on it.

desc.zh: 这名冠军勇士从不知屈服为何物，只懂得以领主之名陷阵厮杀
desc.en: Such a champion will not bend or break, but slay in their Lord's name.

desc.zh: 等待需要的是经验与耐心，这样才能在最出其不意时发动突袭
desc.en: Lying in wait, experienced and patient, striking when the foe least expects.

desc.zh: 引发敌人的纷争和混乱，诱导他们走错方向或迷惑他们的理智
desc.en: To sow discord and confuse the enemy, sending them down the wrong route or befuddling their senses.

desc.zh: 赞美死亡、亵渎神灵的强者足以让敌人的整支军队跪地求饶
desc.en: The sight of a powerful figure extolling death and blasphemies can bring enemy ranks to their knees.

desc.zh: 『若敌人发现我的到来，那就最好不过了！』
desc.en: "If they know I'm coming then more's the better!"

desc.zh: 他们无法阻止自己看不到的家伙
desc.en: They cannot stop what they cannot see.

desc.zh: 这些魔法师聪明过人，并且能够提供不少明智的建议，尤其在他们已经占卜过该区域的情况下
desc.en: Such magic-users may be wise and able to offer sage advice, especially if they have scried the region.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 这名战士一旦出现，其外貌、内涵甚至恶名，都将起到安定军心的效果
desc.en: The sight of this warrior, their stature, import or infamy, can have a calming effect.

desc.zh: 这名英雄技艺超群，熟知各种常见错误，并知道如何才能避免犯错
desc.en: An expert in their craft, this Hero knows all the mistakes that can be made and how to best avoid making them.

desc.zh: 谁想永生呢？其实大多数人都不会拒绝的…
desc.en: Who wants to live forever? As it turns out, most beings wouldn't say no…

desc.zh: 谁想永生呢？其实大多数人都不会拒绝的…
desc.en: Who wants to live forever? As it turns out, most beings wouldn't say no…

desc.zh: 当面对挑战、抉择或单纯只是需要运气之时，人们都会向梦境与幸运女神祈祷
desc.en: Those facing a great challenge, a difficult decision, or simply in need of luck, may call upon the Goddess of Dreams and Fortune.

desc.zh: 知识可以用来当做对抗魔法攻击的护盾
desc.en: Knowledge can be used as a shield against magical attack.

desc.zh: 欺诈之神熟知各种可以对抗远程攻击的计谋
desc.en: The Trickster God knows all manner of ploys and ruses that can be used to counter missile attacks.

desc.zh: 个头越大，就摔得越狠！
desc.en: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

wh3_dlc27_skill_all_dummy_actions_hef_mi.desc_missing_reason: 原版该技能无 localised_description（法术解锁类节点，游戏显示的是所解锁法术的说明）

desc.zh: 海神之怒使幻影咸雾充斥肺腑，这般滋味正是他的军锋艾斯林当年险些遭遇的宿命
desc.en: The Sea God's wrath fills your lungs with phantom brine, a taste of the fate that nearly claimed his Herald, Aislinn.

desc.zh: 迷障薄雾萦绕友方周身，令受困者望见早已陨落的同袍幻影，从而重获力量。然而，这场大捷的预兆始终萦绕着悲怆的余韵
desc.en: A veil of vapour manifests around an ally, invigorating the beleaguered with glimpses of long-fallen kin. A portent of a mighty victory, tinged with the aftertaste of sadness.

desc.zh: 水汽云雾在选定之地升起，水滴不断凝结和蒸发，干扰并减缓来袭箭矢的轨迹
desc.en: Clouds of droplets manifest to continuously form and evaporate around a chosen locale, dampening the path of incoming missiles.

desc.zh: 刹那间，生灵可踏足不朽之路，在现实与虚幻间徜徉
desc.en: For a moment, one may tread immortal pathways by way of drifting in and out of reality.

desc.zh: 凭借对航海巫术的冷酷诠释，柯思奎的贤者们学会了以凝冰封冻猎物，从而令其疲敝无力的能力
desc.en: Through callous interpretation of sea-faring sorcery, Cothiquan loremasters have learned to glaciate their quarry to lethargic helplessness.

desc.zh: 纵使身陷激战幻光之中，阿苏尔之敌仍会为纯水精魂的歌声魅惑纠缠，旋即遭其彻底吞没
desc.en: Even amidst the glamour of pitched battle, the Asur’s enemies are haunted by the beguiling tones of the Oceanids' song, moments before being utterly overwhelmed by them.

desc.zh: 带有腐蚀性盐晶的诡异迷雾笼罩战场，瓦解敌军斗志的同时以灵质触须庇护阿苏尔
desc.en: A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.

wh3_dlc27_skill_all_magic_mists_mathlann.desc_missing_reason: 原版该技能无 localised_description（法术解锁类节点，游戏显示的是所解锁法术的说明）

desc.zh: 编织虚无缥缈的海雾是一项多变而难以捉摸的工作，但它能带来保护，免受变幻莫测的深渊之主的伤害
desc.en: Braiding the ethereal sea mists is a fickle and wayward endeavour, but it brings protection from the mercurial Lord of the Depths.

desc.zh: 转移和操纵自然雾气涡流以隐匿他们的行动，迷雾法师会通过无形的谋划占据优势
desc.en: Shifting and manipulating natural eddies of fog to obscure their movements, the Mist Mage gains an edge through unseen machinations.

desc.zh: 附魔蒸汽随咒语聚集，渐织成无可穿透之帷幔，覆于白衣军团之上
desc.en: The ensorceled vapours gather with each incantation, gradually weaving an impenetrable shroud upon the white-garbed host.

desc.zh: 迷雾笼罩之时，战士们会变得身手迅捷、适性优秀，直到发起进攻时才被敌人所发现
desc.en: Once swathed in the mists, the warriors become swift, adaptable, and unseen until the moment they strike.

desc.zh: 在多年的服役中，此人学到了很多东西，现在他将精力放在了培训其他同僚身上
desc.en: Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

desc.zh: 在多年的服役中，此人学到了很多东西，现在他将精力放在了培训其他同僚身上
desc.en: Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

desc.zh: 对于身处惊涛骇浪，犹弄潮儿的人来说，狂暴的魔法之风也无非如此而已
desc.en: The turbulent Winds of Magic can do little harm to those who have found harmony amidst its raging currents.

desc.zh: 秩序、纪律和一排坚固的盾牌，这就是击垮混沌远程火力的不二法门
desc.en: The best way to repel the chaotic flurry of missile fire is to meet it with order, discipline, and a stalwart row of shields.

desc.zh: 龙帝指挥着北方各省的每一把剑和矛，他的力量与他的意志相得益彰
desc.en: The Dragon Emperor guides every sword and spear of the northern provinces, inspiring a strength of arms to match an unflinching strength of will.

desc.zh: 从低贱的农民到熟练的射手，东方的每一支箭都会带着龙的力量与优雅尽情翱翔
desc.en: From lowly peasant to expert marksman, every arrow of the east soars with a Draconic power and grace.

desc.zh: 古老的震旦在历史上从未被征服，而轰鸣的大炮与爆炸的火箭将有助于将这一记录延续下去
desc.en: Ancient Cathay stands historically unconquered. Booming cannons and rockets of exploding fire help ensure it will remain so.

desc.zh: 百蹄烈奔，试问何人可承？
desc.en: Who can withstand a charge with the sweeping force of a hundred hooves in unison?

desc.zh: 震旦酷吏冷眼之下，氓隶徒属亦可聚而成军
desc.en: Even the most inexperienced peasant rallies under the cold-eyed gaze of Cathay's most stoic guardians.

desc.zh: 烈焰焚天之时，死亡将如雨而至
desc.en: When fire hangs in the sky above the battlefield, death is sure to rain down upon it.

desc.zh: 震旦军队久经沙场，其战技在无尽的乱世血战中早已饱经历练
desc.en: Cathayan armies have been tested time and again, their skills proven in a tumultuous arena of bloodshed and near-constant war.

desc.zh: 战端既启，身手敏捷便是于远程对射中保身的秘诀了。
desc.en: When the raging of battle begins, swift hands and swifter feet are the keys to surviving at range.

desc.zh: 震旦将士们敏捷、稳重、与子同袍，共赴战场
desc.en: Swift, steady and moving as one, the hardy warriors of Cathay race headlong into battle.

desc.zh: 云层中炽热的光芒，定会令下方任何震旦将士心情激荡
desc.en: A blanket of glowing lights amidst the clouds is sure to stir the heart of every Cathayan warrior beneath them.

desc.zh: 北方诸省的血腥战场，乃是震旦最强战士磨练技艺的舞台
desc.en: The blood-soaked battlefields of the northern provinces are the proving grounds upon which the mightiest warriors of Cathay have honed their craft.

desc.zh: 吃一堑，长一智
desc.en: Every wound that is not fatal is but a lesson to learn from.

desc.zh: 所有心怀荣誉的战士都渴望在龙帝麾下战斗
desc.en: All warriors of honour and pride are eager to fight under the Dragon-Emperor's banners.

desc.zh: 纵使刀折矢尽，猛士仍能以精武之躯力战不已，死中求生
desc.en: When the arrows are spent and the blades are all blunted, this perfect warrior can rely on their well-trained body to keep death from their door.

desc.zh: 各司其职，各尽其责。只要谨遵这句箴言，混沌便会无所遁形
desc.en: A place for everything and everything in its place. Live by this motto and Chaos will stand out like the proverbial sore thumb.

desc.zh: 有些人可能认为行政是项令人厌倦的事务，但这位昊天龙帝的臣民很清楚，有序的社会组织定会高效高能
desc.en: Some may consider administration a tiresome process, but this servant of the Celestial Emperor knows that a tidy society makes for an efficient, effective one.

desc.zh: 龙神谒者的职责是保证天朝遍及宁和，而好奇的天性只是担任这一职务所需技能的一部分
desc.en: An inquisitive nature is only part of the skillset required for the Dragon's questioner, tasked with ensuring harmony prevails over Celestial lands.

desc.zh: 暴力永远都是答案，不是也是！
desc.en: Violence is always the answer, even when it's not.

desc.zh: 认识自身的能力并没什么错，尤其是自身确实很有能力时
desc.en: There's nothing wrong with being aware of one's capabilities - particularly when one is capable of so much.

desc.zh: 欺骗会让人蹙眉，但前提是你被识破了
desc.en: Deception is frowned upon, but only if you're found out.

desc.zh: 意志的交锋绝不容畏缩
desc.en: In a battle of wills, one must not falter.

desc.zh: 即使是色孽，也无法击垮这个人的自制力
desc.en: Even Slaanesh would be unable to break this one's self control.

desc.zh: 无人能够杀死不可捕捉之物
desc.en: No being can kill what it cannot catch.

desc.zh: 明断则慎行
desc.en: Discerning judgement begets prudent action.

desc.zh: 如果知识就是力量，那么此人力量十足
desc.en: If knowledge is power, then this one is powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 『诀窍就是要提前想两步…然后再提前想一步』
desc.en: "The trick is to think two steps ahead… and then think one step ahead of that."

desc.zh: 这家伙能跟食人魔较量掰手腕
desc.en: This one could challenge an Ogre to an arm-wrestling match.

desc.zh: 若是说兵法还有哪里值得学习，那么此人应该还没碰到呢
desc.en: If there is anything left to learn about military planning, this one has yet to come across it.

desc.zh: 此人坚定不移，韧性十足，泰然直面所有的挑战
desc.en: Hardy and resilient, this being stands firm in the face of all challenges.

desc.zh: 此人还有用得不精熟的兵器？它还没锻造出来呢！
desc.en: No arms have yet been forged that this warrior has been unable to master.

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 眼前的敌人倒下，鲜血四溅，他随即锁定下一个猎物
desc.en: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 有那么些领主，他们身上散发着力量、自信和威严，激励着他们的追随者执行伟大或可怕的行动
desc.en: There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.

desc.zh: 无数的冲突令这位领主的直觉变得无比敏锐，这使得此人极难落入陷阱
desc.en: Countless conflicts and a keen sense of awareness have made this Lord difficult to entrap.

desc.zh: 『现在正是发动突袭的时刻！』
desc.en: "The time to strike is now!"

desc.zh: 对土地的了解自是一种优势，一种能够让你跑得比别人快的优势
desc.en: Those who know the land and its secrets will travel faster and further than the foes who don't.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 将法杖或是某种奥术导体插入大地之后，有经验的施法者便会有效地束缚魔法之风，从而大大降低施法事故的触发概率
desc.en: By stabbing a staff or some arcane conduit into the ground, an accomplished magic-user can earth or tether the Winds and hopefully reduce a chance of miscasting.

desc.zh: 一些魔法使用者有能力储存魔法之风以备日后使用，从而强化他们的施法能力
desc.en: A few magic-users have the ability to store the Winds of Magic for later use, increasing their spellcasting power when it really counts.

wh_main_skill_all_magic_all_11_arcane_co.desc_missing_reason: 原版该技能无 localised_description（法术解锁类节点，游戏显示的是所解锁法术的说明）

desc.zh: 诸神将通过我们的努力净化大地
desc.en: Through our acts, the gods will cleanse the lands.

desc.zh: 该领主希望得到平民的绝对服从，这样他们就没时间策划暴动或小规模叛乱了
desc.en: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

desc.zh: 该领主及其部下皆精于军需统筹，因此即使在逆境中也能满足军队的需求
desc.en: Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.

desc.zh: 一名优秀的军需官能有效率地配发装备和粮食，让补给能持续得更久
desc.en: A good quartermaster can ration equipment and foodstuffs efficiently, making supplies last longer.

desc.zh: 这个领主一旦出现，追随者就会感到安心，从而安抚军心并降低开小差的概率
desc.en: The presence of this Lord ensures a measure of calm, reducing panic and desertion amongst followers.

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阴
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yin unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity.
